result.title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
result.summary: Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. In gated linear recurrences, memory retention depends on state decay, which is shaped jointly by gate parameters A_log and dt_bias and by input activations. In controlled Gated DeltaNet (GDN) experiments, both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training, highlighting the importance of initialization. Therefore, we introduce Dual-Axis Memory Initialization (DAMI), which jointly configures these parameters before training. DAMI assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. A small activation sample calibrates the GDN-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. Across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, DAMI improves average RULER-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points over the corresponding random-initialization baselines. Performance on language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and 2K real-world retrieval remains broadly comparable to those baselines. Our code is available at https://speedai.com/research/dami.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对门控线性注意力有限状态记忆限制长上下文检索的问题，提出 DAMI：在训练前联合配置门控参数 A_log 与 dt_bias，按头分配几何时间尺度、按层设定低-高-低输入敏感度，并用少量激活样本校准实现，在 GDN、KDA、Mamba-2、RWKV-7 上提升 RULER 类检索准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按头、按层分配状态衰减时间尺度与输入敏感度的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的保留时长、视觉证据跨步留存及长度泛化相关，可供核查；但工作为纯文本架构，未涉及多模态验证。
